page.overview:
Who is Aalto?

Aalto was a Force-sensitive Human male youngling of the Jedi Order and a friend of and frequently joined in on the teasing of Obi-Wan Kenobi, Kenobi was not accepted for training as a Jedi Padawan and was sent to the Agricultural Corps. While at a table with Chun during a morning meal at the temple, Aalto teased Kenobi about his failure, loudly stating that they always knew he would not make it. Aalto used a lightsaber.

Aalto first appeared in the 1999 young-readers novel Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force, which was written by Dave Wolverton as the first installment of the Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice series.
